subject: ProcureMax RFP: SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence coordination
messages:
From: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@procuremax.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: samir.patel@procuremax.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ProcureMax RFP: SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence requests for Redwood Inference

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking the time earlier — ProcureMax is moving the security review for our infrastructure vendors to the final validation stage. Attached is our SIG-style questionnaire and an RFP supplement that calls out a few specific artifacts we need for procurement sign-off (SOC 2 report excerpts, ISO 27001 scope statement, encryption key custody proof, and a mapping of controls to your hosted / dedicated / private deployment modes).

Could you confirm the following by COB Friday:
- Whether you can supply a redacted SOC 2 report (most recent) and ISO 27001 certificate (if available)
- A control crosswalk (SIG control IDs -> Redwood control / artifact)
- An evidence delivery plan (carrier, redaction process, and an ETA)

We also prefer DocuSign for any access agreements or exception acknowledgements. I attached the questionnaire as ProcureMax_SIG_Questionnaire_03102027.xlsx.

Appreciate a point person for evidence coordination — I proposed you in the RFP but happy to loop whoever you suggest.

Best,
Angela Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
ProcureMax Inc.
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: ProcureMax_SIG_Questionnaire_03102027.xlsx, ProcureMax_RFP_Security_Supplement.pdf

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@procuremax.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ProcureMax RFP: SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence requests for Redwood Inference

Hi Angela — thanks for the packet and the clear asks. I’ll be the evidence coordinator for Redwood on this engagement.

Quick answers up front:
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (last completed cycle) and our ISO 27001 scope statement.
- We will deliver a SIG control crosswalk mapping to our control families and the artifacts we plan to provide.
- I’ll propose an evidence delivery plan with timelines and a redaction workflow (we use a staged evidence bucket and an escrow-style handoff for high-sensitivity artifacts).

Action plan I’m proposing:
1) Internal intake and artifact triage (we’ll assess what can be redacted vs. replaced by attestation) — target Wed 03/03 EOD.
2) Produce SOC2 redacted excerpt + ISO scope + control crosswalk — target Thu 03/04 EOD.
3) Deliver artifacts via a secure S3 share and a hashed manifest; provide a DocuSign link for any access agreements — target Fri 03/05.

I’m looping Lauren Bishop from Legal for any contract/escrow language and to confirm the DocuSign template. If ProcureMax has required redaction rules, please share — otherwise we’ll follow our standard: redact customer identifiers, IP of third parties, and any operational telemetry that could reveal customer data flows.

Do you have an ETA for when you need final sign-off? We can accelerate if procurement needs it sooner.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

--
Olga Petrov
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ProcureMax RFP: SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence requests — intake notes

Olga — thanks for taking point. Notes from intake / engineering side: we ran a quick artifact sweep this morning. Draft status below (will update after triage):

- SOC 2: We have the Type II report (2026-09 cycle). Legal asked to redact customer IDs and a subset of network diagrams. We can produce a redacted PDF and a TOC highlighting the pages that substantiate common control families (change mgmt, access, logging).
- ISO 27001: We have a scope statement PDF and an attestation letter from our certifying body — attestation available for distribution.
- SIG crosswalk: I started a mapping spreadsheet (redwood_soc2_iso_crosswalk_2027-03-03.xlsx) linking SIG control IDs to our internal control IDs and sample artifacts. Some SIG sections require additional context (third-party dataflows, KMS key provenance) — Karthik, can you confirm the KMS custody notes?
- Evidence delivery: For high-sensitivity artifacts (key custody proofs, detailed telemetry) we recommend the escrow-handled S3 share and one-time access URLs. We’ll generate an evidence_bucket_manifest_v1.csv with SHA256 hashes and redaction markers.

Ask for Legal: Lauren — what minimum redaction level do we permit for SOC 2 excerpts when sending to prospects?

I’ll prepare a prioritized artifact pack for Friday and a short readout doc for procurement.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ProcureMax RFP: SOC 2 / ISO / SIG evidence requests for Redwood Inference

Thanks Olga / Mina — that matches what procurement needs. Two clarifications:
1) For SIG crosswalk, we need mapping at the control activity level where possible (i.e., SIG control -> Redwood control ID -> artifact filename / location). A spreadsheet is fine.
2) On redaction: ProcureMax requires customer identifiers removed; network diagrams can be generalized (keep zones but remove private addressing). If you can provide an attestation for anything you withhold, that will be acceptable for a first pass.

We also prefer the DocuSign access agreement before we accept the S3 link. Can you send the DocuSign link under the company account?

Attached: ProcureMax_RFP_Security_Supplement.pdf (callouts on page 3). ETA: ideally we have an evidence bucket link by Friday morning Pacific.

Regards,
Angela Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager
ProcureMax Inc.

Attachments: ProcureMax_RFP_Security_Supplement.pdf

Angela — thanks, all good. Finalizing items now and confirming timeline. Delivery summary:

- Friday 2027-03-05 09:00 PT: Secure S3 share created with one-time, expiring links. Package will include: redacted_SOC2_excerpt_2026-09.pdf, iso2701_scope_statement_2026.pdf, redwood_soc2_iso_crosswalk_2027-03-03.xlsx, evidence_bucket_manifest_v1.csv.
- DocuSign: I’ve initiated the access agreement under ProcureMax account. DocuSign stub: https://docusign.net/placeholder/px-2027-045 (will populate after signature).
- Redaction & attestations: Where we withhold sensitive details we will include a signed attestation from our Security team (sample_attestation_redaction.pdf).
- Legal: Lauren confirmed the minimum redaction for SOC2 excerpts is removal of customer identifiers and operational IP addressing; anything else requires legal review.

Next steps for you: please confirm recipient emails for the S3 share and we’ll send the access link after DocuSign is complete. Happy to do a short 30-minute walkthrough of the artifact package next week — let me know availability.

Regards,
